title: Open-Meteo historical archive — Boston grid point, 13–21 April 2026
claims: The archive returns a grid point at 42.35501 N, -71.12906 W, elevation 9 m, for 13–21 April 2026.
Daily maximum temperatures over the nine days range from 9.2°C to 25.4°C, with a median of 16.6°C.
Daily minimum temperatures over the nine days range from -0.4°C to 14.0°C, with a median of 6.9°C.
Four of the nine days recorded at least 1 mm of precipitation and four recorded at least 5 mm.
On 20 April 2026 the grid shows a maximum of 10.1°C, a minimum of 1.4°C, 0.4 mm precipitation and maximum wind of 15.7 km/h.
